Minimum Android: 8.0 (API 26). Recommended: Android 12+ (API 31). Target: Android 16 (API 36). Reliable codec control is tested on Android 15 / ColorOS.
OPPO Find X5 with Beyerdynamic AVENTHO 300. aptX HD was verified after Companion association.
Nearby devices permission is used to read connected Bluetooth audio devices. Companion association may be required before codec control is allowed.
Codec switching depends on the Android and OEM Bluetooth stack. A reported capability may still reject renegotiation. The app never reports success without an active-codec read-back.

The app reacts to Bluetooth connection events, Companion presence and boot recovery. A lightweight connected-device foreground service keeps one status notification visible; it does not poll Bluetooth or perform codec work. ColorOS may require auto-launch, background activity and unrestricted battery use.
